mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS candidateId, c.real_name AS realName, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(c.mobile) = 11 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(c.mobile, 3), '****', RIGHT(c.mobile, 4)) ELSE c.mobile END AS mobileMasked, c.sex AS sex, c.email AS email, c.job_id AS jobId, j.job_name AS jobName, c.school AS school, c.major AS major FROM candidate c LEFT JOIN job j ON c.job_id = j.id WHERE TRIM(c.real_name) = #{realName} ORDER BY c.created_time DESC
